# MCP tools

<!-- Generated by scripts/docs/generate.ts. Do not edit by hand. -->

The MCP endpoint exposes a curated set of 15 tools.
Every tool is scoped. `tools/list` returns only the tools the presented API key
or OAuth grant can invoke.

| Tool                   | Scope          | What it does                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| ---------------------- | -------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `list_decks`           | `decks:read`   | List compact deck summaries.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `get_deck`             | `decks:read`   | Read deck metadata and, optionally, compact cards.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `search_cards`         | `decks:read`   | Search and filter cards across decks.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `get_card`             | `decks:read`   | Read one card in full.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `get_learning_stats`   | `stats:read`   | Read accuracy, due counts, and weak cards for a deck.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `get_study_plan`       | `stats:read`   | Request a Clef-informed (with scheduler fallback) study plan. Pick the practice style with `mode` (flashcards, multiple_choice, typed, matching, cloze, mixed) and the intent with `goal`; `goal: "cram"` covers every active card regardless of schedule.                                                                                                                                   |
| `create_deck`          | `decks:write`  | Create a deck.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `create_cards`         | `decks:write`  | Bulk-create cards in a deck.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `import_deck`          | `decks:write`  | Import cards from CSV, TSV, or JSON.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `update_card`          | `decks:write`  | Update one card.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `delete_card`          | `decks:write`  | Soft-delete a card.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `start_study_session`  | `study:write`  | Start a study session without UI. `mode` supports flashcards, multiple_choice, typed, matching, cloze, and mixed; `goal` supports learn, review, cram, retain, and diagnose. Use `goal: "cram"` to revise every active card and `mode: "matching"` for pair matching. When the user wants to study in chat, call `render_study_session` once instead of this tool followed by a render call. |
| `record_review`        | `study:write`  | Append a review result to a session.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `get_study_session`    | `decks:read`   | Fetch the current authoritative study-session snapshot (no UI).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `render_study_session` | `study:render` | Render an interactive study session as the MCP Apps widget: pass `deckId` to start a session (plus optional `mode`, `goal`, `minutes`) or `sessionId` to resume one. Call this as the only tool in the turn — mobile ChatGPT clients do not render a widget whose tool follows another tool call, so do not call `start_study_session` first.                                                |

Scopes are defined in `packages/shared/src/api/mcp.ts`. The same file drives the
server’s `tools/list` and the web app’s MCP settings screen.

## Schemas

Call `tools/list` against a running instance to receive the live JSON Schema for
each tool. The schemas are inferred from the Zod contracts in
`packages/shared/src/api/mcp.ts`; this page intentionally does not duplicate
them, so it cannot drift.

## Audit

Every mutating tool writes a row to `mcp_audit_events`: user, tool, action,
bounded input summary, affected ids, request id, and timestamp. `import_deck`
payloads are truncated before they are stored.
